{{Top|italics=1}}
{{Otheruses|Cho}}
{{Quote|Cho sun is to "dismember," but the term is used specifically in reference to removing an opponent's entire weapon arm.|[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Cho_Sun.jpg|right|thumb|A [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] performs ''cho sun'' on a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]].]]
In [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], '''''cho sun''''' was the act of [[Dismemberment/Legends|cutting off]] an opponent's weapon [[Limb/Legends|arm]].

==Notable Uses==
{{Quote|Slash off their fighting arms, Goir! You'll take them alive.|[[Sedriss QL]] to [[Vill Goir]] about [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]]|<ref name="Dark Empire II (audio)">[[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] performed a ''cho sun'' on his [[Cay Qel-Droma|own brother]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], and then killed him.<ref name="TOTJ">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref> It should be noted that even though Cay Qel-Droma's arm was mechanical, ''cho sun'' still applies because it was the arm with which he dueled.

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] performed ''cho sun'' at least four times: in bars on both [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="SWAOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="SWANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> also during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]] while fighting the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]],<ref name="CW8">{{CW|8}}</ref> and during a [[Duel on Tatooine (Imperial Period)|duel]] with [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] on Tatooine.<ref name="Leg16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref>

On [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was able to apply ''cho sun'' on [[Bol Chatak]] moments before killing her.<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Jedi Knight [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]] executed a ''cho sun'' against Imperial [[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]].

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] accidentally used ''cho sun'' in a sparring match with [[Tenel Ka Djo]], cutting off her left arm when her first lightsaber shorted out due to faulty construction. Any chance of reattaching the arm was thwarted when the faulty weapon, still in the hand holding it, exploded.<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>

[[Lowbacca]] applied a ''cho sun'' on [[Corrsk (Diversity Alliance)|Corrsk]]; given his [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] biology, Corrsk's arm would have regenerated had Lowbacca not sent him out an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] and into his doom.<ref name="TEP">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>

Jedi Master [[Tresina Lobi]] performed a successful ''cho sun'' strike against [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]], during [[Duel in the Fellowship Plaza|their duel]] in Coruscant's [[Fellowship Plaza]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] applied a ''cho sun'' strike on her twin brother Darth Caedus during the [[Second Battle of Roche]], slicing his arm off at the elbow,<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> mirroring his grandfather's injury during his [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first duel]] with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="SWAOTC" />

[[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] received a ''cho sun'' strike from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[44 ABY]].

[[Darth Nihl]] finessed a ''cho sun'' while dueling [[Wolf Sazen]] during the [[Massacre at Ossus]].<ref name="SWL">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> Nihl himself lost an arm while fighting [[Cade Skywalker]] at the [[Temple of the Sith]].<ref name="SWL19">[[Legacy (2006) 19|''Legacy'' (2006) 19]]</ref>

[[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Tealart]] received a ''cho sun'' to his right arm from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Drok]] following a failed assassination attempt on [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]].<ref name="Legacy 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref>
